find: REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA updater FROM control_room_private_web;
replace: GRANT UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA updater TO control_room_private_web;
why: the web login may read the display tables and change nothing: the mutation must target the REVOKE itself, because replacing an earlier GRANT is undone by this very line
